AnnuityTiming.description: When the payments of an annuity or perpetuity occur.

oneOf.description: Payments at the end of each period (first payment at t = 1).
Payments at the beginning of each period (first payment at t = 0).

Compounding.description: How often interest is compounded within a year.

oneOf.description: Once a year: the rate is an effective annual rate.
Twice a year (nominal rate / 2 per half year).

Rounding.description: Rounding of the amount that the schedule type keeps constant (SPEC-0009 R19).

decimal_places.description: Number of decimal places, from 0 to 6 (2 rounds to the cent).

mode.description:
`half_up` or `half_even`; required, there is no default mode. A missing mode is
reported as `FM-E001` naming `rounding.mode` and its allowed values.

oneOf.description: A half is rounded away from zero (0.125 to 0.13).
A half is rounded to the even digit (0.125 to 0.12, 0.135 to 0.14).

balloon_amount.description:
Amount repaid at the end of the last period on top of the last instalment, in currency
units, at least 0 and lower than the principal. Default: 0.

compounding.description: Compounding of `rate` (form a); required with `rate`, no default.

periodic_rate.description:
Rate per payment period, decimal fraction (form b), greater than -1; instead of `rate`,
`compounding` and `payment_frequency`.

principal.description: Amount borrowed, in currency units, greater than zero.

rate.description:
Annual borrowing rate, decimal fraction (0.05 = 5% a year), quoted with `compounding`.
Rate form (a): give it with `compounding` and `payment_frequency`, or give
`periodic_rate` instead.

rounding.description: Rounding of the instalment. Default: none (no rounding).

timing.description:
`ordinary` (in arrears: instalment k at the end of period k) or `due` (in advance: at the
beginning of period k).
